grades: Rising grades 9 to 12, plus select rising 8th graders
name: Rebel Start Summer Camp
org: UNLV Youth College and Career Readiness
what_you_do: Take 2 college classes for dual credit (people skills and leadership). Explore careers and join campus tours, workshops and speakers.
who_can_apply: Rising 9th to 12th graders and select rising 8th graders from any high school. Outreach to Title I schools and students from groups with fewer opportunities.
pay_detail: $110 registration and enrollment fee. Scholarships available for students with financial need.
deadline_text: Page lists Summer 2026 applications opening December 1, 2025. No closing or 2027 dates posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Get More Info link on the page for the online form. Questions: 702-895-3375 or coe.yccr@unlv.edu.
notes: Page still shows the 2026 cycle. Expect applications to open around December again, and confirm with UNLV.
